_meta.description: SSCG golden dataset for automated retrieval benchmarking
_meta.labeled_by: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Q01-Q35), Claude Opus 4.8 (Q36-Q67), Claude Fable 5 (Q100-Q133, hard-query expansion), Claude Sonnet 5 (H001-H067 subset, commit-mined bug-fix expansion), Claude Sonnet 5 (H035/H068 top-up, ADR-0021 re-grade)
_meta.normalization: Chunk IDs have line-range portions stripped (e.g., 'file.py:10-20:type:name' -> 'file.py:type:name') for stability across code churn
_meta.expected: chunk IDs with label >= 2 (used for Recall@k, NDCG@k)
_meta.expected_primary: chunk IDs with label == 3 (used for MRR)

categories.D: Connection Queries (use find_connections, not ranked search)
categories.E: Path/Flow Queries (use find_path to trace call-graph route between two symbols)
categories.F: Similarity Queries (use find_similar_code to find near-duplicate implementations)

splits.note: Stratified by category: A=9/3/3, B=8/3/3, C=10/3/3, D=8/3/3, E=4/2/3, F=4/2/3. Category D excluded from run_sscg_benchmark.py by default (searcher cannot traverse call graph); include with --category D. H: train 25/val 6/test 6. H top-up: +2 test (H035, H068).

baseline_metrics.note: Baseline from first system version evaluated 2026-01-30

current_metrics.note: DSPy agent eval 2026-06-26, 4-tool (search_code,find_connections,find_path,find_similar_code), 18 test queries (A-F coverage, 77-query dataset). Recall@7=0.9046 MRR=0.8519 NDCG@5=0.8116 Hit@7=1.0 tool_sel=1.0. Traj_recall=0.9537 (gap=+0.049). Phase C reranker experiment: gte-reranker-modernbert-base validated as best available on laptop (bge-v2-m3 scored worse: R@7 0.621 vs 0.696 gte baseline; jina-v3 OOM on 8GB GPU — listwise single-pass fires 3x/query, no fp16, batch_size silently dropped). Searcher-only SSCG baseline (63q, 2026-06-26): MRR=0.700 R@7=0.696 Hit@5=0.984 R@10=0.734.

Full stale-gold audit via new scripts/benchmark/audit_golden_dataset.py against the freshly reindexed live index (2,316 chunks / 2,063 normalized IDs): 19 unresolvable golds in 16 queries, all traced to a dedup_key normalization asymmetry — evaluation/metrics normalization (search/chunk_id.py dedup_key) rewrites split_block -> parent kind (method/function) only for 4-part IDs carrying a line range; live index IDs always carry line ranges while golden IDs never do, so a 3-part golden split_block:X can never match even when the live index still chunks that symbol as a split_block. Splits stratified: A 16/5/5, B 2/1/1, C 1/1/1 (train/val/test).

Removed Q109/Q110 (ONNX backend-selection and ONNX-conversion queries) as part of the ONNX dormant-code deletion: their gold targets (embeddings/model_loader.py:method:ModelLoader._should_use_onnx; embeddings/onnx_loader.py:method:ONNXModelLoader.convert_if_needed and friends) were deleted with no functional equivalent to retarget to. Also dropped the dead embeddings/onnx_wrapper.py:method:ONNXEmbeddingModel.cleanup distractor (grade 1) from Q125's relevance_grades. Splits restratified: A 15/4/5 (was 16/5/5).

Added 37 H-category queries (Q100-Q133-adjacent, id-prefixed H not Q to keep the commit-mined batch visually distinct): bug-fix localization queries mined from single-file/<=2-gold commits, paraphrased from commit subjects (evaluation/commit_mined_candidates.json, benchmark_results/h_candidates_paraphrased.json) and graded via live search at k=10 across 2 rounds (scripts/benchmark/grade_candidate_queries.py --candidates). All intended golds graded 3 as-is (no manual sibling/near-miss grade-2 embellishment this round). H012 and H067 had an invalid intended gold (mcp_server/server.py:function:app_lifespan, a stale pre-refactor ID) corrected to the grader's suggested mcp_server/server.py:decorated_definition:app_lifespan. Dropped H042 as an exact duplicate of H041 (same query text and gold, different source commit). Excluded H035/H060/H061/H068 despite being found in top-10 during round 1: round 2 (an identical re-run scoped to round 1's passers) dropped all four to pool_miss against the same live index -- bf16 neural-reranker batch-composition non-determinism changes score ordering for borderline candidates between runs of different query-set sizes, and a single lucky run isn't enough signal to fix these into a golden set. Splits: train 25 / val 6 / test 6. 126 I-category candidates (multi-file or >2 golds) remain out of scope.

H064: retargeted after ADR-0025 (commit fde9a44) collapsed HybridSearcher.clear_index from a 65-line implementation to a 4-line delegator to IndexSynchronizer.clear_index, moving the BM25-files-per-model rmtree logic the query describes into BM25Index.clear (search/bm25_index.py:456-458, reached via IndexSynchronizer.clear_index at index_sync.py:336). The old sole gold (HybridSearcher.clear_index) no longer contains the behaviour the query asks to change. expected_primary retargeted grade-3 to BM25Index.clear (owns the rmtree); IndexSynchronizer.clear_index added at grade 2 (sequencer deciding what gets cleared); HybridSearcher.clear_index kept at grade 1 (legitimate entry point). Comparability break vs. the pre-refactor canon: H064 moves from one gold to three.

Re-graded H035/H060/H061/H068 under the ADR-0021 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 determinism pin (scripts/benchmark/grade_candidate_queries.py --candidates benchmark_results/h_candidates_paraphrased.json --only H035,H060,H061,H068), superseding the 2026-08-02 bf16-non-determinism exclusion rationale for these four IDs (ADR-0021 showed the actual cause was PYTHONHASHSEED set-iteration order). Promoted H035 as a stable, reproducible pool_miss with a clean query and a verified gold -- a genuine hard case, not noise. Promoted H068 with its intended gold corrected from CodeIndexManager.get_similar_chunks to CodeIndexManager.get_similar_chunks_batched (the method commit 06501b66 actually added, and the one multi_hop_searcher.py calls; same stale-intended-ID pattern as H012/H067). Rejected H060 (commit-narrative query text describing test-fix symptoms, not any behavior of its gold) and H061 (gold does not perform the GPU-memory-tier-management the query describes; that logic lives in search/vram_manager.py:VRAMTierManager instead). Splits: both new queries assigned test.

changes: Q12: mcp_server/tools/status_handlers.py:method:handle_get_index_status kept as-is. It is the normalize_chunk_id form of the three split_block fragments the adaptive-sizing indexer (repo P75 threshold) stores for this 105-line decorated_definition; the static-threshold fresh chunker never splits it. tests/unit/evaluation/test_golden_set_guard.py now accepts the method: alias for split-eligible nodes (kind function/decorated_definition, longer than chunking.max_chunk_lines) instead of the gold being rewritten to a form the index does not hold.
